Bengaluru profile location is distinct from current role location. Conflicting or historical locations remain explicit.
Employee departures are not used to infer replacement vacancies. Recruiter posts are leads until an actual current requisition is confirmed.
Certifications and historical Pega experience identify potential employers to investigate, not proof every current team uses Pega.
